title: Aberration - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Aberration in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: No elemental weakness and a Dark resistance. One of the enemies that is simply a damage race rather than a puzzle.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toNone
ResistsDark
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

No elemental weakness to exploit. Dark is resisted, so avoid leaning on it. Build for raw output and survivability instead.

sections.title: How to Beat the Aberration
sections.content:
Nothing to exploit

This enemy has no elemental profile at all, which is why it is absent from the weakness charts. Damage type does not matter - hit count, Break application and parry timing do.

What not to bring

  • It resists Dark, so that damage is halved.
